english: I am proud that I never missed a single dose of my TB medication.
reference_sesotho: Ke ikantse hore ha ke eso lahleheloe ke dose le e le 'ngoe ea meriana ea TB ea ka.
nllb_output: Ke motlotlo hore ebe ha ho mohla nkileng ka fetoa ke meriana ea ka ea TB.

english: Set a daily alarm on your phone to remind you to take your medicine.
reference_sesotho: Beha alarm ea letsatsi le leng le le leng mohaling oa hau ho u khumamisa ho nka moriana oa hau.
nllb_output: Beha alamo ea letsatsi le letsatsi fonong ea hao ho u hopotsa hore u noe meriana ea hao.

english: Take your medicine with a commitment to completing the full course.
reference_sesotho: Nka moriana oa hau le boikarabello ba ho phetela khoroso yohle.
nllb_output: Nka meriana ea hao u ikemiselitse ho e sebelisa ka ho feletseng.

english: Anyone with a cough lasting more than two weeks should be evaluated for TB.
reference_sesotho: Motho ofe kapa ofe ea nang le ho kohoa ho feta libeke tse peli o lokela ho hlahlobeloa TB.
nllb_output: Motho e mong le e mong ea nang le ho khohlela ho tšoarellang ka nako e fetang libeke tse peli o lokela ho hlahlojoa hore na o na le TB.

english: Acyclovir is used to treat herpes zoster in people living with HIV.
reference_sesotho: Acyclovir e sebelisoa ho phekola herpes zoster ho batho ba phelang le HIV.
nllb_output: Acyclovir e sebelisetsoa ho phekola herpes zoster ho batho ba nang le HIV.

english: Voluntary medical male circumcision reduces the risk of HIV in men.
reference_sesotho: Ho circumcision kapa ho koba banna ka boithatelo ho fokotsa kotsi ea ho tšoaetsoa ke HIV ho banna.
nllb_output: Lebollo la bongaka la banna la boithatelo le fokotsa kotsi ea ho tšoaetsoa ke HIV ho banna.

english: Lobola and other cultural practices can sometimes increase HIV risk and need to be discussed openly.
reference_sesotho: Lobola le ditsheho tse dingwe tsa setso di ka oketseka tšiamo ya HIV mme di hloka ho buiwa ka botjha.
nllb_output: Lobola le mekhoa e meng ea setso ka linako tse ling e ka eketsa kotsi ea HIV 'me e lokela ho tšohloa ka bolokolohi.

english: Take the missed dose as soon as possible, and continue as directed by your doctor.
reference_sesotho: Nka dose e lahlehileng kamoo ho khonehang ka potlako, mme u tsoele pele joalo ka ha ngaka ea hau e laetsa.
nllb_output: Nka lethal dose le lahlehileng kapele kamoo ho ka khonehang, 'me u tsoele pele ho latela litaelo tsa ngaka ea hao.

english: If you miss a dose, use a pill organiser to help you remember in the future.
reference_sesotho: Haeba u lahlehetsoe ke dose, sebelisa pill organiser ho u thusa ho hopola nakong e tlang.
nllb_output: Haeba u hloloheloa tekanyetso, sebelisa sesebelisoa sa ho hlophisa pilisi ho u thusa ho hopola nakong e tlang.

english: Community education reduces TB stigma and encourages people to seek care.
reference_sesotho: Thuto ea sechaba e fokotsa kekello ea TB le ho khothaletsa batho ho batla tlhokomelo.
nllb_output: Thuto ea sechaba e fokotsa ho tšoaroa hampe ha TB 'me e khothalletsa batho hore ba batle tlhokomelo.

english: Take the missed dose as soon as you remember, and continue the prescribed course.
reference_sesotho: Nka dose e lahlehileng hang hang ha u hopola, mme u tsoele pele le khoroso e laetsoeng.
nllb_output: Nka tekanyo eo u sa kang ua e noa hang ha u hopola, 'me u tsoele pele ka tsela eo u e laetsoeng.

english: Self-stigma occurs when a person living with HIV internalises negative beliefs about themselves.
reference_sesotho: Kekello ea motho ka bo eena e etsahala ha motho ea phelang le HIV a amohela mehopolo e mebe ka ho iphumana.
nllb_output: Ho itšepa ho etsahala ha motho ea nang le tšoaetso ea HIV a nahana ka lintho tse fosahetseng ka eena.

english: Long-distance truck drivers are a key population for HIV prevention interventions.
reference_sesotho: Bashofori ba litraka tsa leeto le lelelele ke sechaba se bohlokoa bakeng sa meketso ea thibelo ea HIV.
nllb_output: Bakhanni ba literaka tse tsamaeang hole ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea batho ba thibelang tšoaetso ea HIV.

english: Foster care and adoption programmes support children who have lost parents to HIV.
reference_sesotho: Mananeo a tlhokomelo ea ho hlokomela le ho amohela bana a tshehetsa bana ba lahlehetseng ke batsoali ka lebaka la HIV.
nllb_output: Mananeo a ho hlokomela bana le a ho ba amohela a tšehetsa bana ba lahlehetsoeng ke batsoali ba bona ka lebaka la HIV.

english: I feel a pressure in my chest when I breathe.
reference_sesotho: Ke ikutloa khatello sefubeng ha ke hema.
nllb_output: Ha ke hema, ke ikutloa ke hatelloa sefubeng.

english: I need to book an appointment for a counselling session.
reference_sesotho: Ke hloka ho buka appointment bakeng sa session ea keletso.
nllb_output: Ke hloka ho bokella kopano bakeng sa seboka sa boeletsi.

english: Line probe assays (LPA) can rapidly detect resistance to first and second-line TB drugs.
reference_sesotho: Li-assay tsa line probe (LPA) li ka fumana kapele khakanyo ea meriana ea TB ea mola oa pele le oa bobeli.
nllb_output: Liteko tsa line probe (LPA) li ka lemoha ka potlako ho hanyetsa lithethefatsi tsa TB tsa mola oa pele le oa bobeli.

english: I have a rash on my whole body that is very itchy.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le ho ruruha ha letlalo 'meleng oa ka ka bophara ho hlohlonang haholo.
nllb_output: Ke na le pherekano 'meleng oohle e nkhathatsang haholo.

english: Improved TB diagnostics are needed to detect all forms of the disease accurately.
reference_sesotho: Litlhahlobo tse ntlafetse tsa TB li hlokeha ho fumana mefuta yohle ea bolwetse ka nepo.
nllb_output: Ho hlokahala hore ho be le tlhahlobo e ntlafalitsoeng ea lefu la TB e le hore ho ka fumanoa mefuta eohle ea lefu lena ka nepo.

english: Point-of-care TB diagnostics improve access to testing in remote and resource-limited settings.
reference_sesotho: Litlhahlobo tsa TB tsa sebaka sa tlhokomelo li ntlafatsa phihlello ea liteko libakeng tse hole le tse hlokang mehloli.
nllb_output: Tlhahlobo ea lefu la TB sebakeng sa tlhokomelo e ntlafatsa mokhoa oa ho etsa liteko libakeng tse hōle le tse nang le mehloli e fokolang.

english: I am HIV-positive and I want to donate blood to help others.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le HIV mme ke batla ho fana ka mali ho thusa ba bang.
nllb_output: Ke tšoaelitsoe ke HIV 'me ke batla ho fana ka mali ho thusa ba bang.

english: I feel a squeezing sensation in my throat when I breathe.
reference_sesotho: Ke ikutloa maikutlo a ho kama molaleng ha ke hema.
nllb_output: Ha ke hema ke ikutloa ke tenehile molaleng.

english: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted TB services and led to an increase in TB deaths between 2020 and 2022.
reference_sesotho: Lefu la COVID-19 le phephetse litshebeletso tsa TB mme la lebisa ho eketseheng ha lifu tsa TB pakeng tsa 2020 le 2022.
nllb_output: Lefu la seoa la COVID-19 le sitisitse lits'ebeletso tsa TB mme la lebisa keketsehong ea mafu a TB lipakeng tsa 2020 le 2022.

english: Food requirements for ART medicines vary and patients should be counselled accordingly.
reference_sesotho: Litlhoko tsa lijo bakeng sa meriana ea ART li fapana mme bakuli ba lokela ho fuoa keletso ka ho latela.
nllb_output: Litlhoko tsa lijo bakeng sa meriana ea ART lia fapana 'me bakuli ba lokela ho eletsoa ka tsela e loketseng.

english: Emergency medical services are available for life-threatening conditions.
reference_sesotho: Litšebeletso tsa bongaka tsa tšohanyetso li fumaneha bakeng sa maemo a tšohanyetso a kotsi ea bophelo.
nllb_output: Litšebeletso tsa bongaka tsa tšohanyetso li fumaneha bakeng sa maemo a sokelang bophelo.

english: I have been thinking about ending my life since my HIV diagnosis.
reference_sesotho: Ke nahana ka ho qetela botjha bjale ka tšohle ke ile ka tseba hore ke na HIV.
nllb_output: Ke 'nile ka nahana ka ho felisa bophelo ba ka ho tloha ha ke fumanoa ke e-na le tšoaetso ea HIV.

english: I was told what to expect during labour and delivery.
reference_sesotho: Ke ne ke ile ya tsibiswe ka ho se etsahalang ho tswa ntlele le ho tswala.
nllb_output: Ke ile ka bolelloa seo ke lokelang ho se lebella nakong ea ho beleha le ho pepa.

english: Oral candidiasis presents as white patches in the mouth that can be wiped off.
reference_sesotho: Oral candidiasis e bontsha e le sebaka sa masolle ho molomo o ka qhetellang.
nllb_output: Candidiasis ea molomo e hlaha e le matheba a masoeu molomong a ka tlosoang.

english: Mental health conditions such as depression are treatable.
reference_sesotho: Maemo a bophelo ba kelello joalo ka khutsanyetso a ka alafoa.
nllb_output: Maemo a kelello a kang ho tepella maikutlo a ka phekoloa.

english: Standard precautions must be followed by all healthcare workers to prevent HIV exposure.
reference_sesotho: Tšireletso e tšoanang e swanetse e etsoe ke baahi bohle ba tšehetso ya tšireletso ho hlola HIV.
nllb_output: Basebetsi bohle ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo ba lokela ho latela litekanyetso tse tloaelehileng tsa ho itšireletsa khahlanong le HIV.

english: Place the lozenge in the mouth and let it dissolve slowly.
reference_sesotho: Beha lozenge molomong mme u e lumelle ho nyamela butle.
nllb_output: E behe molomong 'me u e tlohele e qhibilihe butle-butle.

english: Fixed-dose combination tablets make it easier to take ART by combining multiple medicines in one pill.
reference_sesotho: Tabetele e nang le mahlakore a mararo e etsa hore o e je ART ka tsela e bonolo, ka ho etsa hore diphaphathi tse ngata di kwalele motheo o le mong.
nllb_output: Lipilisi tse nang le tekanyo e tsitsitseng li etsa hore ho be bonolo ho nka ART ka ho kopanya meriana e mengata ka pilisi e le 'ngoe.

english: Vaccination against hepatitis B protects your liver.
reference_sesotho: Ho entisoa bakeng sa hepatitis B ho sireletsa sebete sa hao.
nllb_output: Ente e khahlanong le lefu la sebete la B e sireletsa sebete sa hao.

english: Post-traumatic stress disorder can develop after a traumatic event.
reference_sesotho: Maemo a khatello ea maikutlo ka mor'a kotsi a ka hlaha ka mor'a tikoloho e bohloko.
nllb_output: Ho ka 'na ha e-ba le khatello ea maikutlo ka mor'a ketsahalo e bohloko.

english: Civil society organisations play a vital role in TB advocacy and community mobilisation.
reference_sesotho: Mekhatlo ea sechaba sa baahi e bua karolo ea bohlokoa ho boipiletso ba TB le ho matlafatsa sechaba.
nllb_output: Mekhatlo ea sechaba e phetha karolo ea bohlokoa ho buisaneng ka TB le ho kenya letsoho sechabeng.

english: Give the medicine to the child using a spoon if the child refuses the syringe.
reference_sesotho: Fana ka moriana ho ngoana ka sekhoro haeba ngoana a hana syringe.
nllb_output: Fana ka moriana ho ngoana ka sekotlolo haeba ngoana a hana ho sebelisa spray.

english: Can I bring my child to my appointment?
reference_sesotho: Na nka tlisa ngoana oa ka appointment ea ka?
nllb_output: Na nka tlisa ngoana oa ka ho ea kopana le 'na?

english: I was advised to enrol my child in an early childhood development programme.
reference_sesotho: Ke keletsoeng ho ngolisa ngoana oa ka lenanenong la kholo ea bana ba banyenyane.
nllb_output: Ke ile ka eletsoa hore ke ngolise ngoana oa ka lenaneong la tsoelo-pele ea bongoaneng.

english: Palliative care improves the quality of life for people with serious illness.
reference_sesotho: Tlhokomelo ea ho fokotsa bohloko e ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo bakeng sa batho ba nang le mahlwetse a matla.
nllb_output: Tlhokomelo e thibelang mafu e ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo ba batho ba nang le mafu a tebileng.

english: Do not leave the medication in a hot car during summer.
reference_sesotho: U se ke ua siea moriana koloing e chesang nakong ea lehlabula.
nllb_output: U se ke ua tlohela meriana ka koloing e chesang nakong ea lehlabula.

english: I need to know the clinic's appointment hours.
reference_sesotho: Ke hloka ho tseba linako tsa li-appointment tsa kliniki.
nllb_output: Ke hloka ho tseba linako tsa ho ea tleliniking.

english: I was told I may have postnatal depression.
reference_sesotho: Nkae ilo ilo nne nkaitshele hore ke ka na bohloko ba morao-matlafatsi.
nllb_output: Ke ile ka bolelloa hore ke ka 'na ka ba le khatello ea maikutlo ka mor'a hore ke tsoaloe.

english: Regular monitoring helps your doctor know if your ART is working.
reference_sesotho: Tlhahlobo ea madi ea ho beha leihlo lebelo la HIV (HIV monitoring) hangata e etsoa kamora likhoeli tse ling le tse ling tse tharo ho isa ho tse tšeletseng.
nllb_output: Tlhokomelo ea kamehla e thusa ngaka ea hao ho tseba hore na ART ea hao e sebetsa.

english: People who inject drugs living with HIV should receive ART alongside addiction treatment.
reference_sesotho: Batho ba hlabang ka lithethefatsi (people who inject drugs) ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho fumana phekolo ea lithibela-mafofore (ART) mmoho le phekolo ea ho tlohela bokhoba ba lino le lithethefatsi (addiction treatment).
nllb_output: Batho ba nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ba lokelang ho fuoa ART hammoho le phekolo ea ho lemalla lithethefatsi.

english: HIV testing is confidential and your results will not be shared without your consent.
reference_sesotho: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV ho boloka sephiri mme liphetho tsa hau ha li na ho abeloa ntle le tumello ea hau.
nllb_output: Tlhahlobo ea HIV ke ea lekunutu 'me liphello tsa hao li ke ke tsa arolelanoa ntle le tumello ea hao.

english: I would like to be referred to a closer clinic.
reference_sesotho: Ke rata ho romeloa klinikeng e haufi haholo.
nllb_output: Nka rata ho fetisetsoa tleliniking e haufi.

english: I have to go back to the clinic for my test results.
reference_sesotho: Ke tlameha ho khutla klinikeng bakeng sa liphetho tsa tlhahlobo ea ka.
nllb_output: Ke lokela ho khutlela tleliniking bakeng sa liphetho tsa liteko tsa ka.

english: Talking to someone you trust can help relieve stress.
reference_sesotho: Ho bua le motho eo o mo tšepang ho ka thusa ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.
nllb_output: Ho bua le motho eo u mo tšepang ho ka thusa ho imolla khatello ea maikutlo.

english: I have been passing stools that are very pale.
reference_sesotho: Ke ntse ke fetisa manyelo a pheelang haholo.
nllb_output: Ke 'nile ka feta setulong se khanyang haholo.

english: Inform your doctor if you are having difficulty with the frequency of dosing.
reference_sesotho: Tsebisa ngaka ea hau haeba u na le bothata ba hangata ha ho nka dose.
nllb_output: Bolella ngaka ea hao haeba u e-na le bothata ba ho sebelisa litekanyetso ka makhetlo a mangata.

english: Older adults should include balance and strength exercises.
reference_sesotho: Batho ba baholo ba lokela ho kenyelletsa maitlamo a tekanyo le a matla.
nllb_output: Batho ba hōlileng ba lokela ho ikoetlisa ka ho leka-lekana le ka matla.

english: Adults need seven to nine hours of sleep every night.
reference_sesotho: Batho ba baholo ba hloka lihora tse supileng ho isa tse robeli tsa boroko bosiu bo bong le bo bong.
nllb_output: Batho ba baholo ba hloka ho robala lihora tse supileng ho isa ho tse robong bosiu bo bong le bo bong.

english: If you miss a dose of a vitamin supplement, take it as soon as you remember.
reference_sesotho: Haeba u lahlehetsoe ke dose ea sesebelisoa sa vitamin, e nke hang hang ha u hopola.
nllb_output: Haeba u hloloheloa tekanyetso ea tlatsetso ea vithamine, e nke hang ha u hopola.

english: I have pain in my joints, especially my knees.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le mahloko maqhoeng a ka, haholo-holo mangoleng a ka.
nllb_output: Ke na le bohloko ba manonyeletso, haholo-holo ka mangole.

english: The continuation phase of TB treatment lasts four months and uses two drugs: isoniazid and rifampicin.
reference_sesotho: Nako ea ho tsoela pele ea phekolo ea TB e nka likhoeli tse nne mme e sebelisa meriana e mebeli: isoniazid le rifampicin.
nllb_output: Nako e tsoelang pele ea phekolo ea TB e nka likhoeli tse 'nè' me e sebelisa lithethefatsi tse peli: isoniazid le rifampicin.

english: I have a cough that is triggered by chemicals.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le ho kohoa ho qalisitsoeng ke likhemikale.
nllb_output: Ke na le ho khohlela ho bakoang ke lik'hemik'hale.

english: Community health workers play a vital role in TB case finding and patient support.
reference_sesotho: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba bua karolo ea bohlokoa ho fumana liketsahalo tsa TB le tshehetso ea bakuli.
nllb_output: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba bapala karolo ea bohlokoa ho fumaneng linyeoe tsa TB le ho tšehetsa bakuli.

english: Kidney function should be monitored regularly in people taking tenofovir-based ART.
reference_sesotho: Tšebetso ea liphio (kidney function) e lokela ho hlahlojoa khafetsa ho batho ba ntseng ba nka meriana ea ART e nang le tenofovir (tenofovir-based ART).
nllb_output: Ts'ebetso ea liphio e lokela ho hlahlojoa kamehla ho batho ba nkang ART e thehiloeng ho tenofovir.

english: TB can cause permanent lung damage if not treated promptly and completely.
reference_sesotho: TB e ka baka kotsi ea matšoafo e sa foleng haeba e sa phekoluoe ka potlako le ka botlalo.
nllb_output: Lefuba le ka baka tšenyo e sa feleng ea matšoafo haeba le sa phekoloe ka potlako le ka ho feletseng.

english: Do not give the medicine to a child who is on a preservative-free diet without checking.
reference_sesotho: U se ke ua fana ka moriana ho ngoana ea lijo tse se nang li-preservative ntle le ho hlahloba.
nllb_output: U se ke ua fana ka moriana ho ngoana ea jang lijo tse se nang li - preservatives ntle le ho hlahloba.

english: Do not take this medicine with antacid drugs without medical advice.
reference_sesotho: U se ke ua nka moriana ona le meriana ea antacid ntle le keletso ea ngaka.
nllb_output: U se ke ua noa meriana ena hammoho le lithethefatsi tse khahlanong le asiti ntle le keletso ea ngaka.

english: I was told that emergency contraception does not cause an abortion.
reference_sesotho: Ke boletsoe hore thibelo ea ho mitsa ea tšohanyetso ha e baki ho lahla ngoana.
nllb_output: Ke ile ka bolelloa hore thibelo ea ho ima ka tšohanyetso ha e bake ho ntša mpa.

english: My child has been having night sweats and weight loss.
reference_sesotho: Ngoana oa ka o ntse a tsoa molapo bosiu le ho lahleheloa ke boima.
nllb_output: Ngoana oa ka o 'nile a fufuleloa bosiu' me a theola boima ba' mele.

english: I want to ask about the medication supply at this clinic.
reference_sesotho: Ke rata ho botsa ka phepelo ea moriana klinikeng ena.
nllb_output: Ke batla ho botsa ka phepelo ea meriana tleliniking ena.

english: Your CD4 count should be checked regularly when you start ART.
reference_sesotho: Palo ea lisele tsa hau tsa CD4 e lokela ho hlahlojoa kamehla ka mor'a hore u qale phekolo ea lithibela-mafofore (ART).
nllb_output: Palo ea hau ea CD4 e lokela ho hlahlojoa kamehla ha u qala ART.

english: Take your medicine with a glass of water to help it dissolve properly.
reference_sesotho: Nka moriana oa hau le mohope oa metsi ho o thusa ho nyamela hantle.
nllb_output: Nka meriana ea hao hammoho le khalase ea metsi ho e thusa ho qhibiliha hantle.

english: I have difficulty seeing in dim light.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le bothata ba ho bona leseding le fokolang.
nllb_output: Ke thatafalloa ke ho bona ha ke sa bone hantle.

english: This medicine may cause a decrease in bone density with long-term use.
reference_sesotho: Moriana ona o ka baka ho fokotseha ha bongata ba masapo ka tšebediso ea nako e telele.
nllb_output: Meriana ena e ka etsa hore masapo a fokotsehe ha a sebelisoa nako e telele.

english: The nurse printed my results for me to take home.
reference_sesotho: Mooki o hatisitse liphetho tsa ka bakeng sa ho li nka lapeng.
nllb_output: Mooki o ile a hatisa liphetho tsa ka e le hore nka li isa hae.

english: Oral health affects your overall health and wellbeing.
reference_sesotho: Bophelo ba molomo bo angoa bophelo ba hao ka bophara le boiketlo.
nllb_output: Bophelo bo botle ba molomo bo ama bophelo ba hao ka kakaretso le boiketlo ba hao.

english: Take two tablets at bedtime only.
reference_sesotho: Nka lipilisi tse peli nako ea ho robala feela.
nllb_output: Nka lipilisi tse peli feela pele u robala.

english: Drink only safe clean water to avoid waterborne infections.
reference_sesotho: Inua feela metsi a bolokehileng le a hloekileng (safe clean water) ho qoba lits'oetso tse tsamaisang ka metsi (waterborne infections).
nllb_output: Noa metsi a hloekileng feela e le hore u qobe tšoaetso ea metsi.

english: Healthcare workers must treat all patients with HIV with respect and without judgment.
reference_sesotho: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba lokela ho tšepa bakuli bohle ba nang le HIV ka hlompho le ntle le ho ahlola.
nllb_output: Basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo ba lokela ho tšoara bakuli bohle ba nang le HIV ka tlhompho le ntle le kahlolo.

english: ART for children is available in liquid formulations for those who cannot swallow tablets.
reference_sesotho: Lenaneo la ART ke lona le lengwe la bana ba sa tsotobeng tablets.
nllb_output: ART bakeng sa bana e fumaneha ka litlhare tse metsi bakeng sa ba sa khoneng ho metsa matlapa.

english: TB primarily affects the lungs but can also affect the kidneys, spine, and brain.
reference_sesotho: TB haholo-holo e angoa matšoafo empa e ka boetse e angoa lipitso, mokokotlo, le boko.
nllb_output: Tuberculosis e ama matšoafo haholo-holo empa e ka boela ea ama liphio, mokokotlo le boko.

english: Do not store the medication in a location that is subject to extreme temperature changes.
reference_sesotho: U se ke ua boloka moriana sebakeng se angoa ke liphetoho tsa mocheso tsa ho fetisisa.
nllb_output: U se ke ua boloka moriana sebakeng seo mocheso oa oona o fetohang haholo.

english: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome usually occurs within the first three months of ART.
reference_sesotho: Syndrome ea ho bola ha tšireletso ea 'mele hangata e etsahala ka likhoeli tse tharo tsa pele tsa ART.
nllb_output: Hangata mafu a ho ruruha a bakoang ke ho tsosolosoa ha likokoana-hloko a hlaha ka mor'a likhoeli tse tharo tsa pele tsa ART.

english: I feel my whole body is shutting down.
reference_sesotho: Ke ikutloa 'mele oa ka ka bophara o emisa ho sebetsa.
nllb_output: Ke utloa eka 'mele oa ka kaofela oa tima.

english: Give the medicine to the child in a consistent manner to build a routine.
reference_sesotho: Fana ka moriana ho ngoana ka tsela e tsitsitseng ho theha mokhoa.
nllb_output: Fana ka moriana ho ngoana ka tsela e lumellanang e le hore a be le kemiso e tloaelehileng.

english: I was told to keep a diary of my symptoms between appointments.
reference_sesotho: Ke boletsoe ho boloka buka ea letsatsi ea matšoao a ka lipakeng tsa li-appointment.
nllb_output: Ke ile ka bolelloa hore ke boloke buka ea ka ea matšoao pakeng tsa likopano.

english: I have a rash on my upper arms that is blistering.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le ho ruruha ha letlalo mapha a ka a holimo ho nang le li-blister.
nllb_output: Ke na le khohlela matsohong a ka a ka holimo.

english: I feel very sick and my abdomen is very distended.
reference_sesotho: Ke ikutloa ke kula haholo mme mpa ea ka e phahame haholo.
nllb_output: Ke kula haholo 'me mpa ea ka e otlolohile haholo.

english: My child was referred to the nutrition programme at the clinic.
reference_sesotho: Mwana wa ka ile a romelwa ho programme ya tšeho kwenye klinik.
nllb_output: Ngoana oa ka o ile a fetisetsoa lenaneong la phepo e nepahetseng tleliniking eo.

english: Digital health tools such as SMS reminders can improve TB treatment adherence.
reference_sesotho: Lisebelisoa tsa bophelo bo botle tsa dijithale joalo ka litemoso tsa SMS li ka ntlafatsa ho latela phekolo ea TB.
nllb_output: Lisebelisoa tsa dijithale tsa bophelo bo botle tse kang likhopotso tsa melaetsa ea selefouno li ka ntlafatsa mokhoa oa ho phekola TB.

english: I have difficulty breathing and my ankles are swollen.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le bothata ba ho hema mme li-ankele tsa ka li ruruhetse.
nllb_output: Ke thatafalloa ke ho hema 'me maoto a ka a ruruhile.

english: LTBI treatment uptake remains low globally due to lack of awareness, testing capacity, and drug availability.
reference_sesotho: Ho amoheloa ha phekolo ea LTBI ho ntse ho tlase lefatšeng lohle ka lebaka la ho hloka tsebo, bokgoni ba liteko, le ho fumaneha ha meriana.
nllb_output: Ho amoheloa ha kalafo ea LTBI ho ntse ho le tlaase lefatšeng ka bophara ka lebaka la ho hloka tsebo, bokhoni ba ho etsa liteko le ho fumaneha ha lithethefatsi.

english: Breastfeeding mothers living with HIV have increased nutritional needs.
reference_sesotho: Bomme ba anyesang ba phelang le HIV ba na le litlhoko tse eketsehileng tsa phepo.
nllb_output: Bo-'mè ba anyesang ba nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ba na le litlhoko tse eketsehileng tsa phepo e nepahetseng.

english: CD4 count testing is less important once a patient is virally suppressed on ART.
reference_sesotho: Ho lekoa ha palo ea CD4 ho bohlokoa hanyane ha mokuloi a se a laoloa ke vaerase holim'a ART.
nllb_output: Ho hlahloba palo ea CD4 ha ho bohlokoa ha mokuli a hatelloa ke vaerase ka ART.

english: Every positive health choice you make today benefits your future.
reference_sesotho: Khetho le leng le le leng le letle la bophelo bo botle eo o le etsang kajeno le nts'etsa bokamoso ba hao pele.
nllb_output: Khetho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea bophelo bo botle eo u e etsang kajeno e tla u tsoela molemo nakong e tlang.

english: I would like to know when I can resume normal eating.
reference_sesotho: Ke rata ho tseba nako eo nka khutlela ho ja ka tloaelo.
nllb_output: Nka rata ho tseba hore na nka qala ho ja ka tsela e tloaelehileng neng.

english: I was told to watch for danger signs in my newborn.
reference_sesotho: Nkeile ka hloho ho sheba masenyoho a tšohlehang a ngoanana.
nllb_output: Ke ile ka bolelloa hore ke hlokomele matšoao a kotsi ho lesea la ka le sa tsoa tsoaloa.

english: Cognitive behavioural therapy is effective for depression and anxiety in people living with HIV.
reference_sesotho: Phekolo ea maitshwaro a mahutu e sebetsa hantle bakeng sa ho nyamela le ho tšaba ho batho ba phelang le HIV.
nllb_output: Kalafo ea boitšoaro ea kelello e sebetsa hantle bakeng sa ho tepella maikutlo le ho tšoenyeha ho batho ba nang le HIV.

english: Diarrhoea caused by HIV or ART can lead to malnutrition if not managed.
reference_sesotho: Letshollo le bakiloeng ke HIV kapa meriana ea ART le ka baka phepo e mpe (malnutrition) ha le sa laoloe kapa la phekoloa ka nako.
nllb_output: Lefuba le bakoang ke HIV kapa ART le ka baka ho se je hantle ha le sa laoloe.

english: In 2023, approximately 410,000 people developed MDR/RR-TB globally.
reference_sesotho: Ka 2023, batho ba ka bang 410,000 lefatšeng ka bophara ba ile ba tšoaroa ke MDR/RR-TB.
nllb_output: Ka 2023, batho ba ka bang 410,000 ba ile ba tšoaroa ke MDR/RR-TB lefatšeng ka bophara.

english: I am a man who has sex with men and I need HIV prevention services.
reference_sesotho: Ke monna ea nna le monna le ke hloka mesebetsi ea ho fokotsa HIV.
nllb_output: Ke monna ea etsang thobalano le banna 'me ke hloka litšebeletso tsa thibelo ea HIV.

english: You have the right to emergency care even if you cannot pay.
reference_sesotho: O na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso le ha o ke ke oa lefa.
nllb_output: U na le tokelo ea ho fumana tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso esita le haeba u sa khone ho lefa.

english: I have pain in my right ankle that radiates to my heel.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le mahloko ankele ea ka ea le letona a isisoang serethe sa ka.
nllb_output: Ke na le bohloko mokokotlong oa ka o ka letsohong le letona, 'me bo fihla thekeng ea ka.

english: I have a feeling of pain in my ureters.
reference_sesotho: Ke na le maikutlo a mahloko li-ureter tsa ka.
nllb_output: Ke utloa bohloko ka har'a li-ureters tsa ka.

english: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis also provides some protection against malaria.
reference_sesotho: Kotrimoksasoli ya prophylaxis e fana ka tlhofo e seng kae ka go feta le malaria.
nllb_output: Thibelo ea Cotrimoxazole e boetse e fana ka tšireletso e itseng khahlanong le malaria.

english: People with HIV should receive vaccinations to prevent certain opportunistic infections.
reference_sesotho: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho fumana liente (vaccinations) ho thibela mafu a itseng a tlatsetso (certain opportunistic infections)
nllb_output: Batho ba nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ba lokela ho entoa ho thibela tšoaetso e itseng ea monyetla.
